text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Oka Sho just around the 
corner—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah♪ I'm in top shape...!
—Love-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I heard from Chrono-chan~! She said her 
leg is completely healed!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪ I just got the official 
stamp of approval from the teacher the 
other day♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay~! I'm happy at 120 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Then this means we'll go head-to-head at 
the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the real thing. 
I'll make sure I'm fully prepared too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ I'm going to get super lovely too, 
so look forward to it, okay?♡
—The day of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—This year, that Junior Class Queen girl 
has gotta be the top contender, right?! 
She was amazing in the Tulip Sho too...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about that. Personally, I think 
Gran Alegria is pretty incredible too. 
Winning her first graded stakes like that 
is seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's finally Loves-chan's Classic race...! 
Please, let her finish safely...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —...Mm-hmm♪ Feeling in top shape...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I'm ready whenever you 
are...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, I'm ready whenever you 
are...!

Loves Only You arrived at the Oka Sho in 
peak condition. Her focus today seems 
absolutely flawless as well...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you once again, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you once again, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me, I am able to 
run in this race today—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me, I'm able to 
run in this race today—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I know it's going to be a fiercely 
tough battle. Even so, please believe in 
me and watch...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll run in a way that answers your trust!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll run in a way worthy of your trust!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(—So this is the atmosphere of a Classic 
race paddock...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm getting chills...♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: âLoves-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan! You're already at the 
paddock."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to burn the view from 
here... into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I know I've said this many times 
already, but... It still... makes me truly 
happy."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to run alongside Love-chan 
like this... in the Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You know, deep down inside, I feel this 
wonderful, warm glow too♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I will not lose today. The name etched 
into this year's cherry blossoms... shall 
be Chrono Genesis."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— Then maybe I'll add some love to the 
cherry blossoms and make them even more 
vibrant♡

—Then I'll show them what "the strongest" 
looks like.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Gran-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm going to tell Sakura.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—I don't call myself the genius of the 
mile for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...As expected, at this distance, you—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing... My whole body feels like it's 
trembling...! I've never felt like this 
before...!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan right now is just the absolute 
loveliest...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Right? After all, this is—my territory!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: But I have no intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll answer your call, Gran-chan. I'll 
take on your mile with my own running!
